name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Standardize the "confidence cap" toggle across all creative agents. Right now, Luma’s agents run at 65% confidence for borderline clips, but the AI Executive Assistant’s build pattern still uses a 75% cap, creating inconsistent quality gates. One agent should enforce the 65% rule everywhere—no exceptions. Trade-off: stricter gatekeeping slows output slightly, but it prevents the bigger cost of rework from overconfident clips.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s confidence cap fix ignores the 80% of pages that will never hit any gate—those get no quality check at all. Instead, enforce a *minimum* 65% confidence threshold on every agent’s output before it’s passed downstream, and let the 20% that clear it use the 75% gate. The lead should run a 48-hour test: compare error rates in the 65-75% band before and after the change.
